Update Work Order.description: Updates a work order, e.g. to mark maintenance on a cold-chain fridge complete.

Update Asset.description: Updates an asset record, e.g. its status or location after a site visit.

Update Inventory Balances (7.5).description: Updates inventory balances on Maximo 7.5, e.g. after a physical stock count.

Fetch Inventory Item.description: Queries an inventory item and forwards the result to another URL, e.g. an OpenFn webhook.

Fetch Open Work Orders.description: Queries approved work orders for a site and forwards them to another URL.

Fetch Assets.description: Queries assets at a location and forwards them to another URL.
